prompt: How many votes did the opposition party get in the Brant riding the election before Justin Trudeau was elected Prime Minister?
answer: The Liberal opposition candidate received **19,422 votes** in Brantford—Brant in the 2015 federal election, when Justin Trudeau was elected prime minister.
